verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a human-readable API Reference and SDKs, but nothing documenting a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths on the developer site all returned 404. A rendered API reference and SDKs are adjacent features, not the downloadable spec itself, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
